_comment: Example PERSONAL settings for cont_exchange_v2.0 — copy to
Shared rules (deny + UserPromptSubmit auto-archive + PostToolUse hint)
live in .claude/settings.json — committed, applies to everyone.
- permissions.allow: typical project-specific commands you'll want
pre-approved (rsync to dev host, docker compose, validators,
diff tools). Each line bypasses the per-command permission prompt.
- hooks: usually empty here — shared settings.json already covers
UserPromptSubmit auto-archive and PostToolUse post-edit hints.
Add personal hooks ONLY if you want extra automation.
- permissions.deny in shared settings.json CANNOT be overridden here.
- settings.local.json is gitignored — your edits stay on your machine.
- If a command is too broad to safely allow, leave it out and accept
